newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Kurd rebels kill two lorry drivers.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Kurd rebels kill two lorry drivers.

text.p: Kurdish separatist guerrillas killed two lorry drivers in the southeastern Turkish province of Siirt, security officials said on Monday.

The rebels of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) shot the lorry drivers late on Sunday night and set their trucks -- loaded with firewood -- on fire after setting up a roadblock on a main road in the province, an official told Reuters.

Thousands of Turkish troops backed by artillery, armour and helicopter gunships were consolidating their position in neighbouring northern Iraq on Monday after a 19-day foray in pursuit of PKK guerrillas.
Turkey has long complained about PKK attacks from guerrilla bases in northern Iraq.
More than 24,000 people have been killed in the 12-year conflict between Turkish troops and PKK guerrillas fighting for self-rule in the mainly Kurdish southeast of Turkey.
